# Hans van Leeuwen

> Freelance e-commerce manager and marketplace specialist (Amazon & Bol.com), based in Amersfoort, the Netherlands. 10+ years of experience in marketplace strategy, listing optimization, marketplace advertising (Amazon Ads, Bol Ads), conversion rate optimization, UX and digital commerce for brands in the Netherlands and EU.

Hans van Leeuwen helps brands grow on Amazon and Bol.com: marketplace audits, product listing optimization (SEO, A+ Content), PPC management, catalog management, inventory forecasting and monthly performance reporting. Proven results include 70% market share on Amazon NL in the earplug category (Nielsen data) and out-of-stock rates below 2%.

## Services

- [Amazon NL Specialist](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/amazon-nl-specialist): Freelance Amazon Netherlands account management — listings, A+ content, Amazon Ads, growth.
- [Bol.com Consultant](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/bol-com-consultant): Bol.com content optimization, Bol Ads management and marketplace growth strategy.
- [Interim E-commerce Manager](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/interim-ecommerce-manager): Interim marketplace leadership for NL/EU brands — strategy, operations, execution.
